At100 collar/crop and shading shift, but the waxy rendered studio-face appearance remains. Glossier eyes and plastic skin have not become convincingly photographic; no meaningful benefit.

summary.recommendation: Do not proceed to250: no observed photographic/appeal wins, two texture regressions and no improvement in existing failures. Consider only the frozen four-step fallback after root records full one-step failure; no test or production approval.
